title: VideoUrl
description: A video stream URL for a drone. Derived from the region's MAPI getConfiguration sensors: the sensor `videoURL` (an https URL such as https://host:8889/path/a/b) is converted to an rtsp URL by these rules: (1) swap the scheme http(s):// -> rtsp://, (2) replace port 8889 with 8554, (3) strip any trailing slash. Example: https://host:8889/path/a/b/ -> rtsp://host:8554/path/a/b.

videoUrl.description: RTSP stream URL. Scheme rtsp://, port 8554, trailing slash removed; path preserved from the source MAPI sensor videoURL.
